purpose: Test whether critical records previously shown to be baseline DROP -> V3 KEEP in the controlled exhaustive historical scan were independently retrieved by a natural OFF coding-agent search and whether those exact records were visible in the corresponding agent transcript.

interpretation.allowed: natural retrieval plus baseline non-visibility of a record independently known to be V3-rescuable under the controlled exhaustive construction
interpretation.not_allowed: claim that frozen V3 would necessarily keep the record under the exact natural trajectory
